_comment: Hand-labeled (old_text, new_text, correct_relation) triples for evaluating GeometricContradictionJudge's classification precision/recall. Categories chosen to specifically cover the classes of misclassification found 2026-07-20: value_substitution (true supersedes), compression_generalization (the incident's shape -- should be refines, not supersedes), near_duplicate_restatement (should be relates_to), true_elaboration (should be refines), hierarchical_nesting (containment pairs -- relabeled from part_of to relates_to on 2026-07-23 when part_of was removed from the taxonomy; still requires multi_evidence=true so both sides get facet_axes), unrelated (sanity check on the topical gate). `multi_evidence: true` means the pair is built with 3 paraphrased member episodes per side (so facet_axes/refines checks are actually reachable) -- most remember() calls in production are single-evidence, so multi_evidence defaults to false to reflect the common case.
